Internal helper: the stop for an unnamed argument after the variable, with no data frame

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_named_args_stop.Rd

jrecode(), jencode() and jrelabel() under a juse() default, given the variable first and another argument unnamed – jrecode(Age, "1=2"). The stop had rewritten the call by position, "Use jrecode(Age, map = ...)", inline (Session 371, the remedy-line audit): a first argument that was not a variable of the default frame – a data frame's name typed wrong, jencode(dta, Name, map = "a=1") – was offered jencode(dta, map = Name), the map dropped. Now the first argument is checked first, and one the default frame lacks gets the not-found sentence, with the default hint; the call is given back with its one unnamed argument named, on a line of its own, and with several unnamed, or the slot already named, the sentence alone.

Usage

.jst_named_args_stop(fn, arg1, data, data_name, cl, slot)

Arguments

fn

Character. The function's name.

arg1

The resolver's result.

data

The default data frame.

data_name

Its name.

cl

The call as typed.

slot

The argument an unnamed second argument fills ("map", "labels").

Value

Does not return; stops.
